Package com.miniandmore.app.service

Class ZohoItemImageSync

java.lang.Object
com.miniandmore.app.service.ZohoItemImageSync
@Service public class ZohoItemImageSync extends Object
Syncs product images with Zoho Books: push store URLs to Zoho (POST /items/{id}/image) and pull Zoho-uploaded images into store storage on product import.

    • importZohoVariantColorImage

      public void importZohoVariantColorImage(Product product, String color, String zohoItemId, Map<String,Object> item)
      Pull this Zoho SKU's photo(s) onto its print/colour gallery. Zoho has no "print" concept of its own — each size×colour combination is its own Zoho item — but the store treats a print's photos as shared across every size (same model as Ledgerly's colorImagesJson, which has no size axis at all). Every size of a colour is uploaded to Zoho with the same photo set, so the first size we see photos for seeds the colour's one shared gallery; later same-colour sizes must NOT also dump their own (duplicate) photos into it — that would union multiple sizes' sets into one inflated gallery instead of leaving it as the single shared set.

    • hasNativeZohoItemImage

      public boolean hasNativeZohoItemImage(Map<String,Object> item)
      True when Zoho Books has a real item image (image_document_id / image_name). HTTP image_url alone is not enough — leftover CDN links from an older push must not be treated as a live Zoho photo on re-pull.
